messages:
maria: Quick post-PT sync — need to lock down our verification plan for the intake findings. Focus areas: RBAC deltas, KMS key scoping/rotation questions, audit-log sampling, and a short vulnerability sweep to confirm fixes. I sketched a draft below.

jordan: SGTM. Can you paste the actual RBAC diff queries? Want to run them against prod-readonly first.

maria: Yup — core queries: `SELECT * FROM iam_audit WHERE change_type='role_binding' AND ts > '2026-03-01'` (example). For k8s: `kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, subjects:.subjects}'` — filter for serviceaccounts from `redwood-prod-*`.

kevin: For KMS: do we rotate the app key or only the keys used by the pen-test evidence ingest pipeline? My vote: evidence pipeline keys rotate now, application keys after we confirm no regressions.

sasha: Agree with Kevin. Evidence ingest KMS keys are scoped to `evidence-ingest/*` -> rotate immediately, publish new key policy to SRE. For app keys we should run a smoke test matrix first (staging -> canary -> prod).

maria: Plan outline: 1) RBAC diff and targeted rollback window (owner: jordan). 2) KMS rotate for evidence keys + KMS policy audit (owner: kevin). 3) Audit-log sampling to confirm log integrity and retention (owner: sasha). 4) Vulnerability sweep run (owner: maria). 5) Retest slot booking and evidence checklist (owner: all).

jordan: For RBAC diffs I'll run the snapshot tool and create a short PR with recommended rollbacks for high-risk bindings. ETA: EOD today. Will tag `@maria` and `@kevin` in PR.

kevin: KMS rotation plan: will generate new key in staging, update `evidence-ingest` KMS alias, kick a canary ingest, validate signatures and audit entries. Command snippets I'll run:
```
# create key
aws kms create-key --description "post-pt evidence ingest rotation"
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/evidence-ingest-new --target-key-id <id>
# switch alias in staging
```
I'll post logs in the ticket.

audit-bot: Note: Audit export job completed at 2026-03-14T12:00Z. 42GB exported. Link: https://s3.company/audit/exports/4361234567.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

sasha: For audit sampling here's the checklist I propose: - validate sequence numbers for last 7 days - check immutability flags - ensure MPU/retention not truncated - sample 10 events for each high-risk scope (KMS, IAM, SSO).

maria: Vulnerability sweep: run `vulnscan run --targets=prod-apps,ingest --quick` then follow with full scan for any medium+ results. If fixes are config-only, we can fast-track; if code, schedule patch sprint.

kevin: One coordination note: if we rotate evidence keys before retest, we must provide the assessor with the new public key and a timeboxed signing window. I'll prepare a short README on verification steps.

jordan: Retest coordination — I'm opening a calendar block for 2026-03-17 09:00-11:00 (UTC) as the initial verification window. Please confirm availability.

maria: Confirmed for me. I'll also create a JIRA epic `SEC-PT-VERIF-4361234567` and link all tasks. Add remediation owners as sub-tasks.

sasha: One more — RBAC rollback needs a rollback playbook entry: how to revert to pre-change snapshot and how to roll forward after verification. I'll author that and drop in PR.

kevin: If anyone hits logging gaps during sampling ping `#eng-oncall` and tag me. I can enable extra retention temporarily.

maria: Thanks all. Action items: jordan PR for RBAC diffs, kevin KMS rotate and README, sasha audit checklist + rollback doc, me vuln sweep + JIRA epic. Will re-open thread with links once done. :thumbsup:

jordan: Got it.

kevin: On it.

sasha: Will drop docs by EOD.

maria: last note — if the assessor needs evidence replay, prepare a signed event bundle and an HMAC verification script. Example command to verify: `python tools/verify_event_bundle.py --bundle bundle.tar.gz --pubkey pub.pem`.

kevin: I'll generate the HMAC key and publish to the assessor temp-creds bucket with timeboxed ACL.

maria: thread closed for now — will post the PR/ticket links shortly.
